Stella Maris College vs Women's Christian College is a Chennai women's-college science comparison. The subject lists overlap, but the recorded year fees and ranks are not the same.

sections.heading: Stella Maris College vs Women's Christian College for BSc: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Stella Maris College if you want the higher India Today ranks of 7 in 2024 and 8 in 2023, with a recorded year tuition of ₹27,000 on the listed second-shift rows, after you confirm fees for every shift.
Choose Women's Christian College if you want the recorded year tuition of ₹42,333 across several B.Sc subjects, with a 2023 mathematics record of ₹4 lakh average and ₹8 lakh highest.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For Stella Maris we hold ₹27,000 as tuition for one year on the listed second-shift mathematics and psychology rows. Other B.Sc programmes on this page may not have a fee row, so confirm the official circular for every subject and shift.
For Women's Christian College we hold ₹42,333 as tuition for one year on mathematics, physics, chemistry, computer science, psychology, plant biology, zoology and home science.
These are year figures, not confirmed three-year official totals. Check stellamariscollege.edu.in and wcc.edu.in before you budget.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Stella Maris has a 2023 second-shift mathematics row of ₹4 lakh average and ₹5 lakh highest. Women's Christian College has a 2023 mathematics row of ₹4 lakh average and ₹8 lakh highest.
These are historical records for those streams, not a promise for every B.Sc subject. Ask both campuses for a later official report if you need broader figures.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility
paragraphs: No entrance exam is mapped on this page. Follow each college's official undergraduate admissions process.
On our records, Stella Maris has India Today ranks of 7 in 2024 and 8 in 2023. Women's Christian College has India Today ranks of 17 in 2024 and 2023. These are not NIRF ranks.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are women's colleges in Chennai, so a local student can visit them on the same day.
Our table records both as public colleges. Confirm aided and self-financing seat types on the official prospectus, because those can change the fee you actually pay.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick Stella Maris College if the higher India Today ranks and that campus fit you, after you have the official fee for the exact B.Sc subject and shift.
Pick Women's Christian College if the recorded ₹42,333 year tuition and the 2023 mathematics highest of ₹8 lakh are acceptable, after official confirmation.
Match the science subject first. The two 2023 placement rows are both in mathematics, not in every listed programme.
